crossRefs.note: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

translations.web: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
translations.bsb: When a king’s face brightens, there is life; his favor is like a rain cloud in spring.
translations.kjv: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
translations.asv: In the light of the king's countenance is life; And his favor is as a cloud of the latter rain.
